reviews.comment:
Éste ACA en particular está muy  venido abajo, no entiendo porqué, dado a que tiene una buena afluencia de público. Los baños en particular dejan mucho que decear, la atención de las oficinas es con  desgano, la apariencia en general no te invita a quedarte. Espero se pongan las pilas para atraer más publico.

(Translated by Google)
This particular ACA is really run down, I don't understand why, given that it has a good flow of customers. The restrooms, in particular, leave a lot to be desired, the staff at the offices are unenthusiastic, and the overall appearance doesn't make you want to stay. I hope they get their act together to attract more customers.
